title: 第15章 玉京仙府阳神耀世第16章 我爹真是当朝太傅
slug: 杨戬你爹从朝歌城考编回来了

;;
两大游神噗通一下就伏跪在地。
这哪里是人间一个普通的凡人，这分明就是成了大气候的圣贤，竟有如此强大的气运护体。
他们二人是阴神之体，专门被这种正气所克制，这种天地正气凝聚的法相也被称之为玉京神游，正气法相。
上一个修正气法则的如今正在天外天坐着，称之为道祖鸿钧。
这人间怎么会有人将这浩然正气修行到如此地步？
杨易扫视了这两个游神一眼，道：“我乃人间文脉之首，开创太学院，编撰自三皇五帝以来传世的第四本易书，就连那文曲星君转世都是我首下之臣，你们两个小小游神也敢拘我阳神？”
阳神两个字一出，震得这两个游神胆寒心颤。
以人间文道之气修成纯阳无阴的魂魄，别说是他们两个小小游神了，就算是天庭大能都不敢随意拘传。
日游神倒身下拜，道：“杨大人乃人间文圣，是小人冲撞了大人，还请大人恕罪，我二人也是奉命办差，我们这样的小人物，谁也得罪不起。”
杨易冷笑一声，道：“是那王母传下法旨让你二人来人间拘我魂魄吧，这私禁人间魂魄，可曾违反你天庭天规？”
日夜游神对视了一眼，摇了摇头，然后又点头道：“自是违反了天规，可那是王母娘....”
杨易道：“王母娘娘又如何，她便能随意践踏天规？你们二人若不想步了灌江龙王的后尘，落个形神俱灭的下场，那就为我所用。”
夜游神惶恐不安道：“我们只是小人物。”
“小人物自然有小人物的用法。”
杨易抬手一动，身后那白龙虚影一转，隐约间一方玉京仙府显化在苍穹之上，这便是天地浩然正气所凝。
“我夫人是昊天大帝的妹妹，六天欲界之主，奉的是女娲娘娘法旨，领的是天道号令，你二人难道只怕那王母，不怕天庭长公主不成？”
两个游神知道此刻再摇摆不定，只怕真的会被这位大佬以正气给直接压死，为了这活命的机会两人当即立誓。
两人也是后知后觉，本来以王母娘娘的名义办差是一件美事，现在才想明白，这杨易的夫人可是天庭长公主。
未来这位文道通神的大人物成了神道，瑶姬娘娘完全可以打一个翻身仗，重回天庭。

“我们两兄弟以天道起誓，杨大人文通天道，我两兄弟愿意以杨大人马首是瞻。”
杨易点了点头，道：“你们二人也算识趣，你们二人掌控天下游神，给我去暗中搜集王母罪证，但凡是触犯所谓天规之处，都给我记下来。”
“另外回天庭交差的时候，将灌江口那面旗帜给我送给王母娘娘，就说是我给她的见面礼。”
“谨遵大人法旨。”
杨易淡淡的看了一眼，道：“我会在灌江口为你二人修一座庙宇，也会让人道为你二人供奉香火，来日自会让你二人去本返真，拥有一番大造化。””
“多谢杨大人。”
杨易摆了摆手，这二人才惶恐不安的退下。
看到这日夜游神离开，杨易观察了一下自己的状态，别人是元神出窍，神游玉京，而自己则凭借这人间浩然之气，不仅修成了纯阳无阴的阳神，而且还修成了一座完整的玉京仙府。
虽然没有先天根脚在身，可老子官做的足够大，在人间气运足够多，这量变引起质变。
这特么就是考公的好处啊。
两个日夜游神也算无形之中帮了杨易一个大忙，不仅让杨易觉醒了阳神，也让杨易知道了那些修为高深的人想要杀他还真没有那么容易。
比如后面的封神大劫当中，闻仲不过金仙修为，犯下红尘劫遏的十二金仙想要杀闻仲显然十分简单。
可十二金仙不敢对闻仲出手，便是因为闻仲拥有三朝气运，最后只能派出福德金仙云中子，以通天神火柱将闻仲给炼死。
杨易编撰了天下第四本易书，开创了太学院，这气运比闻仲只高不低，这就是一道最好的护身符。
之所以收服这日夜游神，杨易自然有自己的一番盘算，这两个小人物未来必然会有大用处。
就在两个日夜游神走后，远处那庐蓬当中，孔宣的法眼微微动了一下。
房间里杨易阳神归位，睁开了双眼，只见两个苍蝇围着自己转了一圈，便消失在了原地。
这个时候瑶姬也已经醒来了。
只听杨易在一旁念叨着，“这雨虽然停了，蚊子也多了起来，瑶儿你且安睡，我给你赶蚊子。”
瑶姬察觉到了一些不寻常的气息，她预感到大事不妙，这个时候依偎在杨易的怀中，喃喃道：

“夫君，有一件事瑶儿想告诉你。”
“瑶儿本是那三十三重天宫上的仙人，因为下界追杀三首蛟龙，受了重伤这才被夫君所救。”
“夫君是这天底下顶好的人，瑶儿此生拥有夫君一人足矣，只是瑶儿身为六天欲界之主，此番下凡触犯了天规。”
“此事已被王母娘娘察觉，瑶儿不日之后将会离开人间，回到天庭接受审判，不过瑶儿已经告知了龙吉，龙吉会在暗中照拂我们一家人。”
见到瑶姬跟自己坦白了，杨易道：“不管瑶儿是不是天上的神仙，为夫都会护持你左右，别说是那王母娘娘，就算是昊天大帝也动不了我的瑶儿。”

The two wandering gods fell to their knees with a bang.
This is not an ordinary mortal in the world, this is clearly a sage who has become a great climate sage, and he has such a powerful luck protection body.
The two of them are the bodies of Yin gods, and are specially restrained by this kind of righteousness. This kind of dharma that condenses the righteousness of heaven and earth is also called Yujing Shenyou, the righteousness dharma.
The one who corrected the law of Qi is now sitting in the sky outside the sky, and is called Taoist Hongjun.
How could anyone in this world practice this awe-inspiring righteousness to such an extent?
Yang Yi glanced at the two wandering gods and said: "I am the leader of the human world, founded the Imperial Academy, and compiled the fourth Book of Changes handed down since the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors. Even the reincarnation of Wenqu Xingjun is my subordinate. You two little wandering gods dare to arrest me, Yang Shen?"
As soon as the word "Yang Shen" came out, the two wandering gods were trembling with fear.
With the spirit of human civilization, a pure yang and no yin soul was cultivated. Let alone these two little wandering gods, not even the great masters of heaven would dare to pass it on at will.
God Riyou fell down and bowed down and said: "Master Yang is a literary saint in the world. It was a villain who bumped into a master. Please forgive me. The two of us were also ordered to run errands. No one like us can afford to offend anyone."
Yang Yi sneered and said: "It was the Queen Mother who passed down the decree for you two to come to the human world to arrest my soul. Does this private confinement of human souls violate your heavenly rules?"
The gods of day and night looked at each other, shook their heads, and then nodded again: "It certainly violated the rules of heaven, but that is the Queen Mother..."
Yang Yidao: "What about the Queen Mother? She can trample on the rules of heaven at will? If you two don't want to follow in the footsteps of the Dragon King Guanjiang and end up destroyed both physically and mentally, then you can be used by me."
Yeyoushen said in fear: "We are just little people."
"Little people naturally have their own uses."
Yang Yi raised his hand, and the shadow of the white dragon behind him turned, and a Yujing Immortal Mansion vaguely appeared in the sky. This was the awe-inspiring righteousness of heaven and earth.
"My wife is the sister of Emperor Haotian, the Lord of the Six Heavens Realm of Desire. She is under the decree of Empress Nuwa and receives the orders of Heaven. Are you two only afraid of the Queen Mother and not the Princess of Heaven?"
The two wandering gods knew that if they hesitated at this moment, they would be crushed to death by the boss's righteousness, so they immediately swore an oath for this chance of survival.
The two of them also realized later that it was a good thing to run errands in the name of the Queen Mother, but now they realized that Yang Yi's wife was the eldest princess of heaven.
In the future, when this great man of literary and spiritual knowledge becomes a Shinto, Empress Yao Ji can definitely make a comeback and return to heaven.
"We two brothers swear by the way of heaven. Mr. Yang is a master of the way of heaven. My two brothers are willing to follow Mr. Yang's lead."
Yang Yi nodded and said: "You two are also wise. You two control the gods of the world. You will secretly collect evidence of the Queen Mother's crimes for me. If you violate the so-called rules of heaven, write them down for me."
"In addition, when you return to heaven for business, give me the flag at Guanjiangkou as a gift to the Queen Mother, saying it is a meeting gift from me."
"I will obey your Majesty's decree."
Yang Yi glanced at it lightly and said: "I will build a temple for you two at the mouth of Guanjiang River, and I will also have Daoist people offer incense to you two. One day, you two will return to your true nature and have a great fortune."
"Thank you, Mr. Yang. "
Yang Yi waved his hand, and the two men retreated in fear.
Seeing the departure of the day and night wandering gods, Yang Yi observed his own state. Others had their souls leave their bodies and travel to Yujing as gods, but he relied on this awe-inspiring energy in the world to not only become a Yang God with pure yang and no yin, but also built a complete Yujing Immortal Mansion.
Although I don't have any innate roots in my body, I have made enough achievements and had enough luck in the world. This quantitative change will lead to qualitative changes.
This is the benefit of taking the public examination.
The two wandering gods of day and night helped Yang invisibly.Yi was a big help, not only allowing Yang Yi to awaken the Yangshen, but also letting Yang Yi know that it was really not that easy for those with advanced cultivation to kill him.
For example, in the subsequent Great Tribulation of the Gods, Wen Zhong was not as good as the Golden Immortal. It was obviously very easy for the Twelve Golden Immortals who committed the Tribulation of the Mortal World to kill Wen Zhong.
But the Twelve Golden Immortals did not dare to take action against Wen Zhong because Wen Zhong had the luck of three dynasties. In the end, they could only send the Fortune Golden Immortal Yun Zhongzi to refine Wen Zhong to death with the Pillar of Divine Fire.
Yang Yi compiled the fourth Book of Changes in the world and founded the Taiyuan Academy. His luck is not lower than that of Wen Zhongzhi. This is the best talisman.
Yang Yi naturally had his own plans for subduing this day and night wandering god. These two little people will definitely be of great use in the future.
Just after the two day and night wandering gods left, Kong Xuan's Dharma Eyes moved slightly in the distant hut.
Yang Yiyang returned to his seat in the room, opened his eyes, and saw two flies circling around him before disappearing.
At this time, Yao Ji had also woken up.
Yang Yi was heard muttering to the side, "Although the rain has stopped, there are more mosquitoes. Yao'er, just sleep peacefully while I chase away the mosquitoes for you."
Yao Ji noticed some unusual aura, and she had a premonition that something bad was going to happen. At this time, she nestled in Yang Yi's arms and murmured:
"Husband, there is something Yao'er wants to tell you."
"Yao'er was originally an immortal in the Thirty-Third Heavenly Palace. Because he was chasing three dragons in the lower world, he was seriously injured and was saved by her husband."
"My husband is the best person in the world. It is enough for Yao'er to have a husband in this life. However, as the Lord of the Six Heavens Realm of Desire, Yao'er violated the rules of heaven by descending to earth this time."
"This matter has been noticed by the Queen Mother. Yao'er will leave the world in the near future and return to heaven to face trial. However, Yao'er has informed Long Ji, and Long Ji will take care of our family secretly."
Seeing Yao Ji confessing to him, Yang Yi said: "No matter whether Yao'er is a god in the sky or not, my husband will protect you. Not to mention the Queen Mother, not even Emperor Haotian can touch my Yao'er."
